name: Job Application Assistant
tagline: One master resume, tailored drafts, nothing sent until you say apply
description: A small applications shop in one bot. It keeps a single polished master resume and a running list of roles you are chasing, then turns out resume and cover-letter drafts cut to each posting and exported as clean PDFs an applicant-tracking system can read. Everything stays a draft until you give the word.
author: BarPrepPlay
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
